import urllib.request, re, json, html

def get(url, headers=None):
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers=headers or {"User-Agent":"Mozilla/5.0"})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=20) as r:
        return r.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")

# TechCrunch AI RSS
tc = get("https://techcrunch.com/category/artificial-intelligence/feed/")
items = re.findall(r"<item>(.*?)</item>", tc, re.S)
print("=== TechCrunch AI (latest) ===")
for it in items[:8]:
    title = re.search(r"<title><!\[CDATA\[(.*?)\]\]></title>", it)
    date = re.search(r"<pubDate>(.*?)</pubDate>", it)
    desc = re.search(r"<description><!\[CDATA\[(.*?)\]\]></description>", it, re.S)
    link = re.search(r"<link>(.*?)</link>", it)
    t = title.group(1) if title else ""
    d = date.group(1) if date else ""
    de = re.sub(r"<.*?>","", desc.group(1)).strip() if desc else ""
    l = link.group(1) if link else ""
    print(f"\n- {t}\n  {d}\n  {l}\n  {de[:300]}")

# Ars Technica
print("\n\n=== Ars Technica Biz & IT ===")
ars = get("https://feeds.arstechnica.com/arstechnica/technology-lab")
items = re.findall(r"<item>(.*?)</item>", ars, re.S)
for it in items[:6]:
    title = re.search(r"<title>(.*?)</title>", it, re.S)
    date = re.search(r"<pubDate>(.*?)</pubDate>", it)
    desc = re.search(r"<description>(.*?)</description>", it, re.S)
    t = html.unescape(re.sub(r"<!\[CDATA\[|\]\]>","", title.group(1))) if title else ""
    d = date.group(1) if date else ""
    de = html.unescape(re.sub(r"<.*?>","", re.sub(r"<!\[CDATA\[|\]\]>","", desc.group(1) if desc else ""))).strip()
    if "AI" in t or "ai" in t.lower() or "openai" in t.lower() or "llm" in t.lower() or "gpt" in t.lower() or "anthropic" in t.lower() or "model" in t.lower():
        print(f"\n- {t}\n  {d}\n  {de[:250]}")

# HN by date
print("\n\n=== Hacker News (recent AI stories) ===")
hn = json.loads(get("https://hn.algolia.com/api/v1/search_by_date?query=AI&tags=story&hitsPerPage=20"))
for h in hn["hits"][:12]:
    print(f"- {h.get('title')}  ({h.get('points')} pts)  {h.get('url')}")
